title: Autonomous mechanism investigation of DMA N-demethylation
difficulty_reasons: The agent must formulate a chemically meaningful mechanism space, discover and discriminate transition states and intermediates, and justify search coverage and stopping.

paper.title: Mononuclear Non-Heme Iron(III)-Peroxo Complexes in Oxidative N-Demethylation Reaction as a Chemical Model Study of Rieske Oxygenases
paper.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society

data.description: Self-contained 67-atom 1RC Fe(III)-peroxo 12-TMC plus DMA Cartesian geometry.

required_deliverables.description: Proposed and validated candidate mechanisms, connectivity, electronic barriers, conclusion, provenance, and limitations.
